ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory Politically Exposed Persons (PEP) screening of all Directors, Shareholders, and UBOs against the OFAC SDN list, the United Nations Security Council Consolidated List, the UK/HM Treasury sanctions list, the EU sanctions list, the Australian DFAT list, and the Marshall Islands domestic sanctions and terrorism listings. Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) is required for PEPs or where the counterparty is located in a jurisdiction flagged by FATF. For the low-risk commercial soundscape licensing marketplace, Standard Due Diligence (SDD) applies, combined with transactional monitoring for Stripe and PayPal payment rails.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Marshall Islands Office of the Registrar of Corporations – corporate name clearance and reservation application submitted through a licensed registered agent (official portal of the RMI Corporate Registry)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: English is the official statutory language. Corporate names must be formed in Latin alphabet characters; non-English names must be transliterated into English. The name must include a corporate designator ('Corporation', 'Incorporated', 'Company', 'Limited' or an approved abbreviation such as 'Corp.', 'Inc.', 'Co.', 'Ltd.'). The name must be distinguishable from every existing RMI registered entity and any foreign company registered to transact business in the Marshall Islands.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, a written administrative appeal must be filed with the Office of the Registrar of Corporations within 15 business days of the notification date. The appeal must include: (i) the proposed name; (ii) a statement of the grounds for review; (iii) evidence that any sensitive-token consent or authorization has been obtained; and (iv) supporting documents demonstrating distinguishability and non-infringement of prior registrations. The Registrar is required to issue a reasoned written decision within 10 business days. If the appeal is denied, the applicant may seek judicial review, including an injunction or declaratory judgment, through the High Court of the Republic of the Marshall Islands.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office is acceptable for day-to-day operational management and external business activities; however, a statutory physical registered office must be maintained in the Marshall Islands at the office of the licensed registered agent. For a non-resident Business Corporation engaging solely in royalty-free stock music licensing, no local staff, premises, or physical assets are required.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low; estimated annual probability of unannounced physical on-site inspection is less than 2% for a non-resident entity with no local business activity. The Office of the Registrar retains the right to conduct inspections of a registered agent's premises and to require production of corporate records, including UBO documentation, under the Registered Agents Act and AML/CFT regulations.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Business Corporations Act 1990 (as amended), Sections 12 (Filing of Articles of Incorporation), 36 (Registered Office and Registered Agent), 44 (Directors and Officers), 45 (Initial Directors)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital requirement; no escrow account mandate for non-resident business corporations.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the corporation adopts the Articles of Incorporation as filed and accepts the issuance of its initial authorized shares to the subscribers as recorded in the books. RESOLVED, that the registered office of the corporation shall be at the address designated by the Registered Agent, Marshall Islands Corporate Services, Inc., and such Registered Agent is hereby appointed. RESOLVED, that the following persons are appointed as officers to serve until the next annual meeting: President and Secretary-Treasurer. RESOLVED, that corporate governance shall follow the Bylaws adopted by the initial directors, and any officer is authorized to execute documents on behalf of the corporation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Majuro (online pre-clearance via registered agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation request incorporating the word 'Corporation', 'Inc.', or 'Limited' (or an abbreviation) to the Registrar. Confirm the name is distinguishable from existing registered names and from names reserved on the domestic and foreign register.
required_dossiers: Proof of non-resident status (if applying directly)
Identity of the person making the reservation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If name is refused for similarity, file a new reservation with a distinctive suffix or obtain a letter of consent from the existing name holder.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Notarization of Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Attorney General / Public Notary, Majuro or any recognized Marshall Islands notary public
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Articles of Incorporation in English, stating the corporate name, purpose, authorized shares, registered agent, and initial directors. Have each incorporator sign the document and execute an acknowledgment before a notary public. If incorporators are non-resident, they may sign before a foreign notary whose certificate is authenticated by apostille or consular legalization.
required_dossiers: Notarized consent and appointment of initial directors
Apostilled power of attorney if signed by a corporate agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct any notarization deficiencies or missing apostille and resubmit to the Registrar within 14 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing and Payment of Fees with the Registrar
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Majuro (physical counter or accredited registered agent portal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the notarized Articles of Incorporation together with the statutory filing fee payment (bank draft or wired funds). The Registrar will examine the document for legal compliance and, upon acceptance, issue a Certificate of Incorporation.
required_dossiers: Covering letter from registered agent (if any)
Certificate of Corporate Name Reservation (if obtained)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a deficiency query, file a curative amendment or supplementary affidavit within 10 business days to avoid rejection.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Appointment of Registered Agent and Registered Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Corporations via the appointed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a licensed Marshall Islands registered agent to serve as the statutory agent for service of process and to maintain the registered office address in Majuro. The agent must execute a consent form and file it with the Registrar. Ensure the registered office address is not a mere post-office box but a physical street address.
required_dossiers: Proof of physical registered office address lease or service agreement
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registered agent withdraws, appoint a successor agent within 30 days to avoid administrative dissolution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Adoption of Corporate Bylaws and Organizational Meeting Minutes
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Initial directors of the corporation (private act, governed by Business Corporations Act 1990)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The initial directors duly appointed in the Articles meet (physically or by written consent) to adopt the Bylaws, establish the fiscal year, and approve the issuance of share certificates to subscribers. Execute Minutes of Organizational Meeting and maintain the minute book in the registered office.
required_dossiers: Share Ledger and Stock Certificate templates
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct any procedural defect in the minutes by adopting a ratification resolution at the next regularly scheduled board meeting.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Government Business License and General Compliance Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Revenue Commissioner, Majuro
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: In addition to incorporation, a non-resident service corporation holding assets for licensing purposes is exempt from domestic business license tax. However, file the mandatory Annual Corporate and Foreign Resident (ACF) Filing and obtain a Tax Identification Number (TIN) for bank account opening and payment processor compliance.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If penalized for late filing, request an abatement under the Revenue and Taxation Regulations for reasonable cause.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable - purely digital commercial soundscape licensing and audio sample subscription marketplace with no physical manufacturing operations
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No industrial operating license required under Marshall Islands law for digital audio royalty collection and licensing activities

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environmental Protection Authority of the Republic of the Marshall Islands
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - no physical facilities, no discharge points, and no hazardous material handling
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable - no wastewater, no VOC emissions, and no solid waste generation; all operations are cloud-based digital file delivery.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not applicable - no physical premises requiring fire safety certification, no structural loads, and no on-site workplace clearance; if a remote office is later established, the relevant Majuro Municipal Building Permit and fire inspection regulations will apply.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Revenue and Taxation Administration (RTA), Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands, with the Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Office of the Attorney General for the corporate register. There is no dedicated taxpayer e-portal; RTA administers the Income Tax Act, the Business License Act, and tax-clearance certificates via paper and email filings (rmi government portal: https://rmigovernment.org).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Non-resident foreign-owned Business Corporations are not issued a TIN. The statutory procedure for an exempt non-resident BC is: (1) file Articles of Incorporation with the Registrar of Corporations under the Business Corporations Act (Delaware-derived); (2) pay the annual registration/franchise fee to the Registrar; (3) submit a Business License Application to RTA electing the Non-Resident Exempt category; (4) pay the fixed annual business license fee; and (5) obtain the license and, upon request, a tax clearance certificate confirming no RMI-source income. While the entity derives no Marshall Islands-source income, no income tax registration, no income tax returns, and no TIN are required.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box, hybrid-mismatch, or entity-classification elections exist under Marshall Islands law. A Non-Resident Business Corporation is presumptively tax-exempt when all income is foreign-sourced. The only operative election is the statutory choice to apply for, and maintain, the non-resident exempt business license; engaging in local trade or business without that election would convert the entity into a partially taxable RMI-source filer. No partnership or disregarded-entity elections are recognized for RMI tax purposes.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: None (no VAT, GST, or general sales and use tax is imposed; the only indirect levy is customs import duty on physical goods under the Customs and Excise Act)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: N/A (USD) - the Marshall Islands has no VAT/GST/sales tax, therefore no economic turnover threshold exists for indirect tax registration; any local business activity, regardless of revenue, merely requires a business license under the Business License Act 1981 and does not trigger any consumption tax liability.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No electronic invoicing, continuous transaction control, real-time fiscal clearance, or digital stamping regime exists. Issuance of conventional sequentially-numbered commercial invoices or PDF/Stripe-generated receipts is sufficient; no government API integration, pre-clearance approval, or digital tax stamp is required for royalty-free stock music licensing or audio sample subscriptions.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Because the Republic of the Marshall Islands does not levy VAT or GST, the concept of a 0% export VAT rate and export VAT refund is inapplicable. Instead, all revenue from royalty-free stock music licensing and commercial soundscape audio subscriptions qualifies for categorical exemption from RMI tax when the income is derived from sources outside the Marshall Islands, the licensee is non-resident, and the entity holds a valid Non-Resident Exempt business license; no output tax is chargeable and no input tax refund mechanism exists or is needed.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: No customs export declaration or bill of lading is required for intangible audio-licensing exports, as the Customs and Excise Act applies only to physical goods
Executed stock music license agreements and end-user license agreements (ISIC 5920 / NAICS 512240 records)
Digital distribution platform payout reports and Stripe/PayPal account statements evidencing foreign-source consideration
RTA Business License (Non-Resident Exempt) and Registrar-issued certificate of good standing
Board resolutions and ownership records confirming non-resident status and absence of RMI-source revenue
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: There is no export zero-rating clawback regime to enforce because no VAT/GST is levied. The analogous risk is RTA audit recharacterization of claimed foreign-source licensing income as Marshall Islands-source. Penalties include: revocation of the exempt business license; assessment of back corporate income tax at the 3% rate applicable to RMI-source income of a domestic corporation; statutory interest accrual on unpaid assessments; late-filing and negligence penalties up to 25% of the tax due; and, in cases of intentional misrepresentation, monetary fines and recovery of underpaid license fees. Documentary substantiation must therefore be retained for at least six years.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: No indigenous central bank exists. The U.S. dollar is the sole legal tender pursuant to the Compact of Free Association, and monetary conditions are therefore governed by the U.S. Federal Reserve. Banking and foreign-exchange-adjacent supervision is vested in the Banking Commissioner, Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands, acting under the Banking Act 1980 (as amended); the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) administers AML/CFT supervision.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Marshall Islands has no exchange-control law and no separate domestic currency against which conversion could be restricted; current-account and capital-account transactions are freely convertible because the circulating medium is USD itself. The RMI imposes no income tax, capital gains tax, or withholding tax on dividends, interest, royalties, or profit remittances paid by a non-resident Business Corporation, and no advance-approval, repatriation, or utilization requirement applies to foreign-source licensing revenue. Practical hurdles are limited to bank-level AML/KYC evidence of source of funds and FATCA/CRS classification.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Not applicable. The RMI maintains no statutory surrender, mandatory conversion, retention-period, or licensing requirement for export proceeds or service-export receipts. Cross-border royalty income from the commercial soundscape licensing marketplace may be retained offshore, swept to U.S. clearing nodes, or disbursed directly to foreign producers and licensors without regulatory filing or approval.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational USD current account; segregated escrow/sweep sub-account for share-capital pre-funding and dividend accumulation

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of Guam, Republic of the Marshall Islands Branch (Majuro)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational USD account with direct U.S. ABA-clearing node and correspondent-fed wire access
Institutional term-deposit and project-escrow account only; no commercial demand-deposit treasury offering

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-Medium as a direct onboarding rail for the RMI-domiciled entity. Stripe does not support the Marshall Islands as a merchant or payout jurisdiction; PayPal accepts RMI business accounts but requires a U.S. or RMI bank account for withdrawal and functions only as an intermediary settlement rail. Wise, Airwallex, Mercury, and U.S. neo-banks (Brex, Relay, Column) will not onboard the Marshall Islands business corporation directly; legal viability is achieved by interposing a U.S. single-member LLC (check-the-box, disregarded) owned by the MH BC to hold the Stripe/PayPal settlement accounts and a U.S. fintech treasury account, with onward remittance to the MH BC by intercompany transfer. Structural constraint: the U.S. LLC must be documented as an active NFFE under FATCA, must complete U.S. beneficial-ownership (FinCEN BOI) filing, and should be supported by a U.S. tax opinion confirming no unintended U.S. trade-or-business or withholding exposure.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: No statutory mandate exists for physical board appearance at account opening under RMI law; remote onboarding is the operational norm for non-resident entities. In practice, BOMI and Bank of Guam require: (i) certified and apostilled corporate documents (Certificate of Incorporation, Certificate of Incumbency, Register of Directors and Shareholders, Registered Agent certificate); (ii) a board resolution authorizing account opening and signatories; (iii) a live video-conference interview with each signatory and the ultimate beneficial owner; (iv) three months of personal and corporate bank statements; and (v) a couriered original notarized signature block. A registered-agent introduction letter materially accelerates approval.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident, zero-tax offshore business corporation with no local operating substance, flagged as a shell-pattern candidate.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of Good Standing; Certified Articles of Incorporation; Certificate of Incumbency; registered-agent due-diligence certificate; executed customer license agreements and distributor/DSP contracts evidencing active commercial soundscape licensing; 12 months of Stripe/PayPal merchant settlement statements; treasury flow map matching inbound royalty receipts to outbound producer payouts.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ultimate beneficial owner ring consisting of foreign individuals with limited home-bank history or possible PEP association.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified passport and address proofs; three months of principal-bank statements for each owner; banker's reference letter dated within 90 days; PEP self-declaration; source-of-wealth statement supported by tax returns or asset schedules; professional CV and corporate registry affiliations.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume, low-ticket electronic settlements aggregated from third-party processors (PayPal/Stripe) creating mixed-identity money-flow risk.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Processor settlement reports and ledger reconciliation; executed merchant service agreements; invoicing and license-schedule library; OFAC/EU sanctions screening logs on all customers and producers; acceptable-use policy compliance letter; confirmation that payout beneficiaries are pre-verified producer or label accounts with no third-party beneficiaries.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: U.S. correspondent-bank enhanced due diligence triggered by RMI-domiciled corporate flows and historical FATF grey-listing of the jurisdiction.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: FATCA W-8BEN-E (active NFFE) and CRS self-certification; RMI tax-transparency status certificates; current beneficial-ownership register; organizational chart of the U.S. nexus LLC with EIN and state filings; legal-opinion letter confirming no bearer shares, no prohibited structures, and continuous good standing.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Share capital and pre-funded working capital are wired in USD via SWIFT MT103 from the beneficial owner's own account at a recognized bank into the escrow/sweep sub-account. Field 50K must show the remitter name exactly matching KYC records; Field 70 must cite 'SHARE CAPITAL SUBSCRIPTION PURSUANT TO BOARD RESOLUTION DATED [DATE]' or 'DIRECTOR LOAN UNDER FACILITY AGREEMENT DATED [DATE]'. The bank requires the board resolution and shareholder register in advance and internal-codes the credit as equity or loan to support capital-account reconciliation; injections above USD 50,000 typically trigger enhanced source-of-funds review (tax returns and asset statements) and a two-to-five business day clearing hold.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Producer and label royalty payouts: (i) high-value or correspondent-cleared payments are made via SWIFT MT103 through the bank's U.S. correspondent chain; (ii) low-value monthly producer pools are aggregated and remitted via mass-payment APIs (Wise Business, Tipalti, or Payoneer) from the U.S. nexus LLC, or via ACH where counterparties hold U.S. accounts; (iii) commercial letters of credit are not applicable because music-licensing revenue is a service/intangibles flow, not documentary goods trade. All outbound beneficiaries must be pre-screened against OFAC/EU consolidated lists, and a no-third-party-beneficiary policy must be enforced in the payout registry.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable USD/EUR, USD/GBP, and USD/AUD spot-and-forward contracts (1M/3M tenors) executed with a top-tier U.S. or EU counterparty bank to fix producer payment currencies; permitted without RMI regulatory approval because USD is the home currency and RMI law imposes no derivatives restriction.

Cross-currency swaps under an ISDA 2002 Master Agreement, permissible and prudent only where multi-year producer advance or catalogue-acquisition contracts create material long-dated non-USD liabilities.
Natural-hedge multi-currency operating accounts (multi-currency balances via the U.S. nexus or a Wise Business edge) to offset EUR/GBP payables against receivables pockets where contracts permit.

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) are legally permissible offshore but commercially unnecessary and disfavored given the full deliverability, depth, and liquidity of the USD side of all relevant currency pairs.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Report of the Business Corporation (confirmation of name, registered office, registered agent, directors, and authorized share capital; minimum government fee tier for authorized capital of USD 50,000 or less, with higher bands per Registrar schedule)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands (submission effected through the appointed Marshall Islands registered agent)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 60 calendar days after the anniversary of the effective date of the certificate of incorporation; initial report due in the calendar year following incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late penalty of 10% of the annual report fee for each month or part of a month the filing is overdue, capped at 50%; failure to file for three consecutive years authorizes the Registrar to administratively dissolve the corporation, and continued trading after strike-off exposes directors to personal liability

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual AML/beneficial ownership recertification and CDD refresh (identity, source of funds, and control structure confirmation required under the Financial Transactions Reporting Act)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registered Agent acting under the Marshall Islands Financial Transactions Reporting Act; no public beneficial ownership register exists
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Coincident with the annual report anniversary; additionally, within 30 days of any share transfer, issue of new shares, or change in director composition
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: No direct government fine; non-recertification permits the registered agent to treat the corporation as non-compliant, file a report with the Financial Intelligence Unit, or resign, in which case the Registrar may strike off the corporation for absence of a resident agent

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual internal corporate records attestation (annual shareholder and director resolutions or unanimous written consents, register audit, and internal financial statement preparation without statutory filing)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: None (non-filed document; maintained at the registered office or by the registered agent in the corporate minute book)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Completion within the fiscal year-end cycle; the Business Corporations Act permits action by unanimous written consent without holding an annual meeting
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: No government strike-off risk; deficient records weaken evidentiary position in audits, litigation, payment-platform due diligence, and music-licensing counterparty reviews, and may create director liability for default of record-keeping duties in derivative actions

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No mandatory independent audit applies to a non-resident tax-exempt Business Corporation under the Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act unless: (i) shares are publicly listed or traded; (ii) the Registrar specially directs an audit under investigative powers; or (iii) the corporation's articles, bylaws, or a lending/royalty-distribution counterparty covenant requires an audited statement. For this royalty-free stock-music licensing entity, the audit is voluntary unless a payment rail or music-rights licensee mandates one.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS, with US GAAP accepted as an equivalent framework for a non-public Marshall Islands Business Corporation; no locally promulgated Marshall Islands GAAP; books must be maintained in US dollars or with adequate USD conversion and must reflect the true financial position of the corporation.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Annually, each natural person owning 25% or more of the issued shares or otherwise exercising control must execute the registered agent's CDD recertification, submitting a valid passport, proof of address, source-of-funds statement, and affirmation of no restricted activity. Any share transfer, capital allotment, or director change during the year must be recorded in the registers and re-confirmed to the agent within 30 days. No beneficial ownership details are filed with the public Registrar; the agent retains verification records for the statutory retention period.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Certificate of Incorporation and Registered Office/Agent file

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% - Non-Resident Domestic Corporation (NRDC) exemption: the Marshall Islands imposes no corporate income tax on foreign-source income of a Business Corporation. Incidental RMI-source business income (if any) would be taxable at the 3% standard corporate rate under the Income Tax Act 1989 (as amended).
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 0% effective tax rate on all foreign-source royalty, subscription and audio-licensing income; no branch profits tax, no capital gains tax, no payroll/wage tax (no RMI employees), and no withholding tax on distributions. The only statutory impost is the BCA annual franchise tax (from USD 25 on authorized capital not exceeding USD 50,000; scaled thereafter, statutory minimum USD 250) plus registered-agent fees and the government continuation fee; total annual preservation cost typically USD 400-1,000.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Annual Report and Franchise Tax Return (Business Corporations Act 1990, s. 105), filed electronically through the Marshall Islands corporate registry portal (submitted by a licensed registered agent on the MI Registry/IRI online filing system). No income tax return is required to be filed with the RMI Ministry of Finance where the NRDC exemption applies.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due on or before the last day of the month of the corporation's incorporation anniversary each year; the annual report, the government continuation fee and the franchise tax must be lodged together.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exact registered corporate name and BCA registration number.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the exact name as shown on the certificate of incorporation; do not abbreviate; confirm that no name-change resolution is pending.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered agent and registered office address in the Republic of the Marshall Islands.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The registered agent must hold a current RMI license; provide a physical street address in Majuro (a P.O. box alone is not sufficient).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Directors and officers - full names, nationality and residential addresses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Nominee directors may be listed, but the underlying beneficial owner must be disclosed to the registered agent for AML/ESR purposes.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorized capital structure (class, par value and number of authorized shares).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: This field determines the franchise tax assessment; avoid par-value increases without modelling the fee impact.
Describe 'royalty-free stock-music and audio-licensing subscription platform (ISIC 5920)' and certify that no trade or business is carried on within the Marshall Islands.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: NRDC tax-status declaration and certificate attachment.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach the Certificate of Non-Residence/Good Standing issued by the registrar; declare that all income is sourced outside the RMI and that the company has no payroll or premises in the RMI.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late lodgment: statutory surcharge of USD 150 per report plus monthly default additions of USD 50; automatic loss of good standing; after six months of continuous default the registrar may administratively dissolve the BC. Reinstatement requires payment of arrears, all surcharges and a reinstatement fee, without prejudice to ESR penalties for late substance declarations.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% - the Republic of the Marshall Islands levies no withholding tax on dividends paid by a Business Corporation to its shareholders, whether resident or non-resident, and no undistributed-profits tax applies.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: The RMI has no comprehensive double-taxation agreement network, so no DTA-relief or TRC-issuance protocol exists domestically. To substantiate exempt status, the company obtains a Certificate of Good Standing and a Certificate of Non-Residence (NRDC status certificate) from the registrar through its registered agent. This certificate is supplied to licensing counterparties, payment platforms (Stripe/PayPal) and banks; US counterparties require the form W-8BEN-E (with the RMI exemption statement) to claim the applicable statutory/code-based exemption. Any relief from foreign-source withholding is therefore claimed in the source jurisdiction, not in the RMI.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: RMI statutory rate 0%; treaty rate 0% (no DTA in force). Interest: RMI statutory rate 0%; treaty rate 0% (no DTA in force). Foreign payor-side withholding remains the operative exposure: US-source royalty payments to an RMI corporation suffer US FDAP withholding at 30% absent a treaty (unless an exemption applies for platform 'final disposition-style' licensing), and non-US payors may apply domestic withholding (commonly 5-15% post-directive relief in EU states).

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: USD 0 / not applicable - the RMI has no domestic transfer-pricing legislation and prescribes no Local File or Master File thresholds. Contemporaneous substance and pricing records are nevertheless mandatory for all licensing revenue under the Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) 2024; the annual ESR declaration must be filed irrespective of revenue level.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) 2024, issued under the Business Corporations Act, apply to financial years commencing on or after 26 February 2024. A Business Corporation carrying on the Relevant Activity of Intellectual Property Business - which encompasses the exploitation and licensing of copyrighted audio works (ISIC 5920) - must demonstrate: (i) management and control exercised with adequate physical premises in the RMI; (ii) adequate, proportionate staff with appropriate qualifications; and (iii) core income-generating activities (CIGA) performed, and income earned, in a jurisdiction where the company is subject to tax. Where the licensing activity is actually operated abroad, the company must invoke the 'reasonable alternative jurisdiction' route by proving tax residence and substantive operations in an OECD-compliant jurisdiction; otherwise the registrar will impose ESR penalties and may notify the source-state tax authority.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion / NRDC Exemption Misuse (Income Tax Act 1989, as amended)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Claiming the NRDC zero-tax exemption while earning income sourced within the Marshall Islands; concealing RMI-source audio-licensing revenue; knowingly filing false declarations of non-residence with the registrar or foreign payors.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Additions to tax of up to 100% of the amount evaded, fixed penalties of up to USD 25,000 per offense, cancellation of the exemption certificate, and civil recovery proceedings by the Attorney General.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Joint and several liability for evaded tax and penalties; travel bans; and imprisonment for up to five years for willful evasion.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Sham Substance Evasion (ESR 2024 and BCA 1990)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining nominee-only organs with no premises, records, or employees in any jurisdiction while routing licensing income through a tax-exempt BC; shifting effective management to a blacklisted jurisdiction without disclosure.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: ESR corrective notices; financial penalties up to USD 50,000 per assessment year plus USD 1,000 per month of continuing default; strike-off of the BC and onward notification to the source-state tax authority.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal fines, disqualification orders of up to ten years, civil liability for taxes assessed in the substance jurisdiction, and criminal prosecution of officers who certified false ESR declarations.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML/CFT Breach (Financial Transactions Reporting Act 2000, as amended)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Onboarding sanctioned or politically exposed subscribers on the stock-music platform; deliberately obscuring the origin or destination of Stripe/PayPal payouts; failing to maintain a beneficial-ownership register or suspicious-transaction reporting framework.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Entity fines up to USD 1,000,000 per violation, freezing and forfeiture of funds, revocation of the registered agent's license or the BC's registration, and exclusion from using RMI banking corridors.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and compliance officers face personal fines, travel bans, excluded-person orders, and imprisonment of up to ten years in aggravated cases.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Misrepresentation to Foreign Withholding Agents / Tax Information Exchange
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Furnishing falsified residency or beneficial-ownership statements to US/EU licensees to obtain reduced withholding; using the absence of an RMI tax treaty to engineer abusive round-tripping with a related parent.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Foreign penalties: US backup withholding plus a 75% civil fraud penalty on under-withheld amounts; EU GAAR/DAC6 penalties; cancellation of the RMI good-standing certificate and listing on the registrar's non-compliant entities register.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Cross-border enforcement and extradition exposure in treaty states; personal judgments for the under-withheld amount plus interest where the director signed the false certificate.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Continuing the audio-licensing business after administrative strike-off; paying dividends while insolvent; failing to retain accounting records for the statutory period; transferring assets to defeat creditors.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Directors become personally liable for all debts incurred after dissolution; restoration requires a court order with full arrears and penalties; the court may order restitution and disqualification.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal civil judgments and charging orders on beneficial shareholdings; disqualification from acting as a director of any RMI entity; in fraud cases, custodial sentences.
